per_case.answer: Northwind Cloud grants a refund window of 30 days from the date of each charge [doc:doc_refunds]. This 30-day window restarts at every renewal date for annual plans [doc:doc_refunds].
The Growth tier allows 300 requests per minute [doc:doc_rate_limits].
Northwind Cloud guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime on the standard tier [doc:doc_sla].
Northwind Cloud keeps application logs for 30 days [doc:doc_data_retention]. After 30 days, application logs are permanently removed [doc:doc_data_retention].
All data stored on Northwind Cloud is encrypted at rest with AES-256 [doc:doc_encryption]. This encryption uses keys managed by the platform key service [doc:doc_encryption].

First, sign up with an email address and verify it by clicking the confirmation link [doc:doc_onboarding]. Second, create a project from the dashboard by choosing a name and a default region [doc:doc_onboarding]. Third, open the console and generate an API key under Settings and then Keys [doc:doc_onboarding].

Incidents on the Northwind Cloud status page use three severity levels: severity 1 marks a full outage, severity 2 marks degraded performance, and severity 3 marks a minor issue without customer impact [doc:doc_status_page].
Growth adds email support with a first response within 24 hours, available around the clock [doc:doc_support_tiers].
Processing time for a data export is up to 48 hours, although most exports finish in under 30 minutes [doc:doc_export].
Northwind Cloud operates three regions: us-east (Virginia), eu-west (Ireland), and ap-south (Mumbai) [doc:doc_regions].

Northwind Cloud maintains SOC 2 Type II certification [doc:doc_compliance]. This certification is renewed through an annual audit [doc:doc_compliance]. The report for this certification is available under NDA from the trust center [doc:doc_compliance].

When the API returns HTTP 429 due to an exceeded limit, clients should retry with exponential backoff starting at 1 second, with a maximum of 5 retries [doc:doc_rate_limits]. The API response will include a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds to wait [doc:doc_rate_limits]. Retrying immediately without backoff can extend the throttle [doc:doc_rate_limits].

If measured uptime falls below the target, customers can claim a service credit on the next invoice [doc:doc_sla]. The credit formula is 5% of the monthly fee for every 0.1% of downtime below the target, calculated as missed uptime divided by 0.1, multiplied by 5 [doc:doc_sla]. This credit is capped at 50% of one monthly fee [doc:doc_sla].

Northwind Cloud guarantees 99.95% monthly uptime on the Business plan [doc:doc_sla]. Business plan customers receive priority support with a 4-hour response target during business hours, defined as 09:00 to 18:00 UTC from Monday to Friday [doc:doc_support_tiers].
You can export your logs from Northwind Cloud [doc:doc_export]. Northwind Cloud keeps application logs for 30 days [doc:doc_data_retention].
